purpose: Frozen execution-ordering and semantics-preserving physical-deduplication contract. Deterministic ordering is fixed BEFORE outcomes exist. Dedup is an efficiency optimization only and never changes logical arm-level results.

environment_rule.opws_worktree_materialization: INSIDE LINUX from git objects only; Windows/NTFS-materialized trees are INVALID for OPWS execution

physical_execution_identity.note: All five fields must be equal before two logical arm records MAY share one physical OPWS execution.

scope_deduplication.rule: If multiple arms on the SAME task produce exactly the same canonical selected scope hash AND the reference patch hash, test-contract hash, and environment id are all equal, they MAY share one physical OPWS execution.
scope_deduplication.result_mapping: the single physical execution result is mapped back to every corresponding logical arm record.
scope_deduplication.forbidden: never deduplicate merely because scope sizes are equal; equal sizes with different scope hashes are different physical executions

execution_order.principle: deterministic ordering fixed BEFORE outcomes exist; not derived from expected success, gold overlap, or any observed outcome
execution_order.task_key: bound population ordered task IDs (frozen manifest order at binding)
execution_order.within_task: unique canonical scopes for that task ordered deterministically by scope_hash (stable IDs); then logical-arm mapping
execution_order.zero_ordering_inputs_from_outcomes: no ordering by expected success; no ordering using gold overlap; no reliance on Full-D7 outcomes beyond the final frozen eligibility binding
execution_order.reason: task-major ordering enables safe immutable environment reuse per task where the existing harness supports it

rerun_policy.scientific_failures: NO outcome-based reruns. Scientific classes (OPWS_PASS / BEHAVIOR_FAIL / PRESERVATION_FAIL / BEHAVIOR_AND_PRESERVATION_FAIL) are never rerun.

infrastructure_transient.condition: only if the failure matches a PREDECLARED infrastructure transient signature AND no scientific result was produced

rerun_policy.predeclared_transient_signatures: container startup failure, transient network error, transient filesystem/IO lock error, WSL boot race (established in frozen readiness/evaluator infrastructure)
